d:
Cyclone Arnab triggers heavy rain across Odisha, with several areas recording over 100 mm rainfall in 24 hours. Eight affected districts receive ₹19 crore in relief funds, while power restoration continues across cyclone-hit areas. With schools closed and control rooms activated, authorities remain on alert as waterlogging, flooding and infrastructure damage continue to pose challenges.
